question: How many lines achieved a test accuracy greater than 0.6 when number of effective passes is 10?

steps.description: Locate the subplot showing Test Accuracy on the y-axis versus Number of Effective Passes on the x-axis
Find the position of the target value on the x-axis labeled Number of Effective Passes
Identify the y-axis threshold value for test accuracy
Determine which lines cross the x-axis position with y values exceeding the threshold
Note the color of each line that satisfies the criteria from step_4
Count how many lines meet the criteria identified in step_5
